title: Bram and the Kitchen
author: Elodie Nystrom
blurb: Sebastian Whitlock, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
